description: This PHP source file defines the 'Template' class within the 'Todaymade\Daux\Format\HTML' namespace. It manages rendering HTML templates using the Plates templating engine, including configuring the engine, registering template functions, and rendering templates with data. It also handles navigation building and localization features.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Handles HTML template rendering with associated navigation and localization functions using the Plates engine.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Template class with a global configuration object.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Creates or returns an existing Plates engine instance configured with template directories.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a specified template with provided data, augmenting the engine with additional context.

methods.name: registerFunctions
methods.description: Registers custom functions (get_navigation, translate, get_breadcrumb_title) for use within templates.

methods.name: renderNavigation
methods.description: Renders a navigation menu from a hierarchical array of entries.

methods.name: buildNavigation
methods.description: Recursively builds a navigation structure from directory and content nodes.

methods.name: getSeparator
methods.description: Returns SVG or separator string based on input.
